name: Cosmos Video
description_en:
Cosmos Video provides persistent virtual spaces for remote teams and communities, combining availability signals, calls, chat and a visual floor plan. It is intended for ongoing co-working as well as an isolated scheduled meeting.

Capacity is about online people and call participants, not only registered members. The pricing FAQ allows unlimited invited users but imposes plan-specific concurrent limits, and it describes different consequences for exceeding a space limit versus a call limit.
description_zh:
Cosmos Video 为远程团队与社区提供持续虚拟空间，结合可用状态、通话、聊天及可视楼层图，既面向持续共事，也可用于独立会议。

容量涉及在线人数与通话参与人数，不能只看注册成员。定价 FAQ 允许邀请不限用户，但按套餐限制并发，并说明空间上限和通话上限超出时行为不同。

core_features.explanation_en: Team members share a space and indicate whether they are available for real-time interaction.
core_features.explanation_zh: 成员共享空间，并表示是否可实时互动。

core_features.name_zh: 受容量限制的群组通话
core_features.explanation_en: Online-space capacity and participants per call are separately limited.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在线空间容量与每通电话人数分别限制。

core_features.explanation_en: Recording storage, retention and overage depend on plan and downgrade state.
core_features.explanation_zh: 录制存储、保留及超额随套餐和降级状态变化。

en: A remote team can enter a persistent space, see who is free to talk and start a call without circulating a new link for every interaction. Configure member and guest access before opening the space. The FAQ distinguishes owners/admins who manage the space from members and guests.
zh: 远程团队可进入持续空间，查看谁方便交谈，无需每次互动重新发会议链接。开放前先配置成员和访客访问。FAQ 区分管理空间的所有者/管理员，以及成员、访客。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from attached official sources. Product behavior is vendor-documented, not independently tested.
All records remain draft. Chinese prose does not establish a Chinese software interface.

sections.title_zh: 示例：团队共同办公时段
sections.en:
A remote team can enter a persistent space, see who is free to talk and start a call without circulating a new link for every interaction. Configure member and guest access before opening the space. The FAQ distinguishes owners/admins who manage the space from members and guests.

Evaluate a focused colleague, a guest knocking to enter and a call already at capacity. This is an editorial scenario, not a tested workspace. Decide team availability norms so persistent presence does not become an expectation of constant interruption.
sections.zh:
远程团队可进入持续空间，查看谁方便交谈，无需每次互动重新发会议链接。开放前先配置成员和访客访问。FAQ 区分管理空间的所有者/管理员，以及成员、访客。

建议评估专注中的同事、敲门进入的访客，以及已达人数上限的通话。这是编辑场景，未测试工作区。团队应约定可用状态规范，避免把持续在线理解为必须随时被打断。

sections.en:
Free lists four online users and calls of up to four participants. Registered users are unlimited, but every role counts toward concurrent capacity. The FAQ says a full space prevents additional entry; an over-limit call can let extra participants speak while restricting their view of other people and screen shares. Admins receive capacity warnings without automatic upgrade.

Premium is described up to 150 online users. Enterprise call limits conflict: the card says up to 500, while the table says up to 200 despite 500 space capacity. Confirm the contracted call maximum instead of selecting the larger number. Online space capacity and call capacity are not interchangeable.
sections.zh:
Free 列出四位在线用户、每通最多四位参与者。注册用户不限，但所有角色都计入并发。FAQ 表示空间满员后阻止新增进入；通话超限时，额外参与者可能可以发言，却不能看其他人或屏幕共享。管理员收到容量提醒，不会自动升级。

Premium 描述最多 150 位在线用户。Enterprise 通话上限矛盾：卡片写最多 500 人，表格却写最多 200，而空间容量为 500。应确认合同通话上限，不能选择较大数字；在线空间与通话容量不能互换。

sections.title_en: Storage can create costs after a downgrade
sections.title_zh: 降级后存储仍可能收费
sections.en:
The paid per-user numeric price is missing from the retrieved dynamic view, so the amount remains unknown. Monthly/annual choices and a fourteen-day paid-plan trial are described, with a card required for that trial. This differs from the homepage’s no-card Free message.

The recording sections disagree on Free retention: one card says seven days and a table says fifteen. The downgrade FAQ says recordings on Free are held fifteen days before deletion and excess storage may cost $15 per fifty hours. Confirm retention and download recordings before changing a plan. The application was not used and no deletion/recovery test was run.
sections.zh:
读取的动态视图缺失付费每用户数字，金额保留未知。页面介绍月付/年付，以及需要银行卡的十四天付费档试用，这不同于首页无需卡的 Free 信息。

录制部分对 Free 保留期限不一致：卡片为七天，表格为十五天。降级 FAQ 表示转 Free 后保留十五天再删除，超额存储可能每五十小时 $15。改档前需确认期限并下载录制。本次未使用应用，也未测试删除/恢复。

sections.title_en: A virtual office needs access and audio checks
sections.title_zh: 虚拟办公室需要核对访问和音频
sections.en:
Persistent co-working teams may benefit from evaluating the combined space model; someone needing only occasional client calls may prefer a simpler workflow. Establish guest access, recording consent and how people leave a conversation before rollout.

The sources describe a managed service, not an established self-hosted distribution or permissive software licence. Encryption/compliance claims remain vendor statements. Microphone failures, browser behavior, recording completeness, exact billing unit and restoration were not verified.
sections.zh:
持续共事的团队可评估整合空间模型，只偶尔开客户会议的人则需衡量是否过于复杂。上线前明确访客访问、录制同意及退出对话方式。

来源介绍托管服务，未证明自托管发行版或宽松软件许可。加密/合规主张仍为厂商说法，麦克风故障、浏览器行为、录制完整性、具体计费单位和恢复未核实。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: Enterprise call maximum and Free retention conflict within pricing; paid numeric rate missing. Confirm account terms.
research_gaps.zh: 定价内部的企业通话上限与 Free 保留期限矛盾，付费数字缺失，需确认账户条款。

research_gaps.en: No space, role, call, recording, payment, export or recovery test was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试空间、角色、通话、录制、付款、导出或恢复。
